title: BBC Learning English from the News 2026 — Quiz 1
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q001_doesn_t_add_up
elements.title: He says he was away all day, but three people saw him at work. His story ___.

elements.name: q002_screen
elements.title: The clinic will ___ applicants for conditions that could make the trial unsafe for them.

elements.name: q003_stern
elements.title: The teacher gave a ___ warning and made clear that no further delays would be tolerated.

elements.name: q004_scraps
elements.title: Use those vegetable ___ to make stock instead of throwing them away.

elements.name: q005_pure
elements.title: “The race was pure delight from start to finish.” What does “pure” emphasise here?

elements.name: q006_root_to_tip
elements.title: The chef uses carrots from ___, cooking the tops as well as the rest of the plant.

elements.name: q007_on_alert
elements.title: With more storms possible, crews remained ___ and ready to respond.

elements.name: q008_spoiled
elements.title: The milk had ___ in the heat and smelled sour.

elements.name: q009_vulnerable
elements.title: A loose roof tile leaves the building ___ to water damage during storms.

elements.name: q010_turnaround
elements.title: The shop went from losing money to making a profit in three months. Staff called it a remarkable ___.
